metadata.source: Ginoux et al. 2012, Rev. Geophys. 50, RG3005, doi 10.1029/2012RG000388, auxiliary material Middle_East_MAM.kml
metadata.quantity: frequency of occurrence, percentage of days in the season with MODIS Deep Blue dust optical depth at 550 nm above 0.2, 0.1 degree grid
metadata.season: MAM only. Ginoux published one season per region; there is no other for the Middle East.
metadata.caveat: FoO is a frequency of activation, not an emitted mass. The 0.15 surface reflectivity mask makes the product blind to sources on dark surfaces.
